QuestInfo.name: The Secret Square
QuestInfo.0: Meet Claudine in Edelstein to see if she has any insight into the Seal Stone theft.
QuestInfo.1: Claudine tells you to meet her in the Secret Square, because she's scared of being overheard. Get to the Secret Square through the Secret Passage in the sewers.
QuestInfo.2: You meet Claudine in Edelstein to see if she has any insight into the Seal Stone theft.

0.0: As I suspected, this spot is not safe. Meet me at the Secret Square.

yes.0: Search in the #bsewers#k to find the Secret Path to the Secret Square.

no.0: There are Watchmen all around. If you wish to talk, you'll have to do as I request...

1.0: You made it. I hope you weren't followed...

yes.0: My name is Claudine, and yes, I am a member of the Resistance. I already know what you're here for, Explorer...

npc.0: Search in the #bsewers#k to find the Secret Path to the Secret Square. We can talk more there.
